title: A Typo Landed an Innocent Gamer in Prison for 18 Months
gist: A one-sentence teaser reporting that a missing underscore in a Skyrim-themed username led to an innocent Nova Scotia man serving 18 months in prison. The remainder of the article is paywalled, so no supporting detail is available in this record.

themes.theme: Wrongful conviction from a username typo

insights.claim: One missing underscore in a Skyrim-themed username put an innocent Nova Scotia man in prison for 18 months.
insights.speaker: Nate Anderson, Ars Technica
insights.so_what: Limited direct investment relevance; the signal is that username-based attribution can survive to conviction without corroboration, a latent liability for platforms asked to identify users.
